svg.title: Order platform and its data stores
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 10 components and 9 connections in 2 boundaries. Order platform: API gateway, Catalog service, Order service, Order events, Billing worker, Data tier. Data tier (in Order platform): Catalog, Orders, Invoices. Main path: Shopper → Shop app → API gateway → Order service → Order events → Billing worker. Most connected: API gateway and Order service (3 connections each). Nothing leads into Shopper. Nothing leads out of Catalog, Orders and Invoices. Shopper (person): connects to Shop app (orders). Shop app (frontend): connects to API gateway (via HTTPS). API gateway (service): connects to Catalog service (browse) and Order service (checkout). Catalog service (service): connects to Catalog (via SQL). Order service (service): connects to Orders (via SQL) and Order events (publishes). Order events (queue): connects to Billing worker (delivers). Billing worker (service): connects to Invoices (via SQL). Catalog (database): no outgoing connection. Invoices (database): no outgoing connection. Orders (database): no outgoing connection.
svg.text: Order platform and its data stores
